title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The Decision of the AI Office outlines the official stance and guidelines the office will adopt for developing and deploying AI technologies. It sets out the principles, responsibilities, and decision‑making processes the office will use to ensure AI is employed responsibly and ethically.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: The document announces a vacancy for technology specialists who will focus on artificial intelligence work. It highlights that the role will involve developing AI solutions, handling data, and collaborating across teams to advance the organization’s AI initiatives.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: The document announces a vacancy for a Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI Office, describing the responsibilities of guiding scientific strategy and ensuring rigorous research standards. It also outlines the qualifications needed and the application process for interested candidates.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: This policy outlines the responsibilities and qualifications for legal officers tasked with overseeing AI office vacancies. It details the legal oversight functions, compliance requirements, and appointment procedures for these roles.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: The policy document announces that the AI office has vacancies for policy officers and outlines the duties, qualifications, and responsibilities expected of those positions. It also explains the application process and how the new officers will support the organization’s AI strategy and governance efforts.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group of experts that evaluates the technical and scientific aspects of artificial intelligence to help lawmakers craft effective regulations. They review risks, assess AI capabilities, and provide evidence‑based guidance on safety standards and best practices for AI deployment.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: This document proposes a request to create standard guidelines for AI systems. It aims to ensure consistent, reliable, and safe practices across AI development and deployment.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: This notice announces a consultation period for the Community of Practice to gather feedback on proposed AI policy measures. It invites stakeholders to review and comment on the draft policies before they are finalized.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: This document invites interested individuals or organizations to express their interest in joining a Community of Practice (CoP) focused on AI policy. It outlines the purpose of the CoP, the benefits of participation, and the steps to submit an expression of interest.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: This policy document offers a graphic overview of the iterative drafting process, illustrating the stages from initial conception to final review. It emphasizes how feedback is incorporated at each cycle to refine and align the content with community standards.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: The document is a graphic timeline that shows the steps and key milestones in drafting the AI policy. It maps out the stages, dates, and participants involved in developing the policy.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: This document outlines preliminary guidelines for the responsible development and use of artificial intelligence. It sets out principles, best practices, and expected standards for stakeholders to ensure safe and ethical AI deployment.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: The "Code of Practice: 2nd Draft" sets out a set of guidelines for the responsible development and use of artificial intelligence. It includes best practices, ethical standards, and compliance measures aimed at ensuring AI systems are safe, transparent, and fair.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: The Code of Practice provides a set of principles and guidelines for the responsible development, deployment, and use of AI, emphasizing transparency, fairness, accountability, and risk mitigation. It serves as a framework for organizations to adopt safe, ethical AI practices in alignment with emerging regulatory standards.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft outlines a proposed agreement among stakeholders to promote responsible development and deployment of artificial intelligence. It includes guidelines for transparency, accountability, and collaboration to ensure AI benefits society while mitigating risks.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a comprehensive agreement that brings together governments, industry leaders, and civil society to set global standards for artificial intelligence. It establishes shared responsibilities, safeguards, and cooperative frameworks to promote safe, ethical, and inclusive AI development and deployment.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: The document lists AI activities that are forbidden, such as creating harmful deepfakes, manipulating elections, and deploying autonomous lethal weapons. It serves as a regulatory framework to ensure AI is used responsibly and ethically.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: The document explains what counts as an AI system, describing key features such as learning from data, making predictions or decisions, and adapting over time. It also offers a framework for identifying these elements in technology products so that organizations can manage compliance, risk, and accountability.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: This policy outlines strategies to improve communication and collaboration within the start‑up ecosystem, aiming to boost innovation and accelerate business growth. It proposes initiatives such as mentorship programs, networking events, and digital platforms to connect entrepreneurs, investors, and industry stakeholders.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: EuroHPC is launching a program to help new companies build on high‑performance computing resources. The initiative offers funding, mentorship, and access to state‑of‑the‑art HPC infrastructure to accelerate innovation and competitiveness.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar will cover key topics in risk management, providing participants with practical tools and strategies for identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks. Attendees can expect interactive sessions, case studies, and expert insights to help them implement robust risk management practices.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: The webinar explores essential risk management strategies for organizations using AI, covering how to identify, assess, and mitigate potential threats. It highlights best practices for developing robust policies, monitoring systems, and ensuring compliance with evolving AI regulations.
